method: Public primary product pages; no purchase or private editor audit. Promotional customer counts were not independently verified or reused.

sources.name: LovePanda
observations: Digital album and animated retrospective with personal photos, music and letters; recipient opens in browser.
Live examples and preview before purchase. Public album prices observed: R$19.90 for 24 hours, R$29.90 ongoing access, R$39.90 complete plan.
sources.application: Show real recipient examples and distinguish formats. Keep Capimimo original artwork and family-wide occasions; do not reproduce competitor screens or code.

sources.name: Festino
observations: Invitation examples, guided form, individual RSVP/party counts, map and calendar.
Public one-time price R$99.90; access through event plus 60 days; post-payment access to creation.
sources.application: Separate public demonstration from creator panel. Give each invited family a name, allowed party size, own invitation and email draft. Keep local response import honest until server exists.

sources.name: LovyMemory
observations: Four guided screens for name, photos, message and music; preview before checkout.
Public price R$10 for one year; R$20 for two years.
sources.application: Do not position Capimimo as the cheapest in the market. Compete through readable layouts, full-family themes, offline keepsakes and richer personalization.

decisions: Public page: working examples, concise product choice, no full editor by default.
Post-purchase UI: explicitly simulated access until payment and server authorization exist.
Thirty options per occasion and core format: ten compositions × three curated color directions. Cover/background art restricted to margins; opaque text zones.
Keep R$14.90/R$24.90/R$39.90 as a launch proposal, not validated conversion or profit claims.
Do not promise permanent hosting or automatic email/WhatsApp in this local version.
